describe: Start a web server for the current project

options.describe: Path to project configuration file in YAML format
Path to a YAML file containing the project's dependency tree. This option will disable resolution of node package dependencies.
Path to workspace configuration file in YAML format
Name of the workspace configuration to use
A list of tasks to be added to the default execution set. This option takes precedence over any excludes.
A list of tasks to be excluded from the default task execution set
Port to bind on (default for HTTP: 8080, HTTPS: 8443)
Open web server root directory in default browser. Optionally, supplied relative path will be appended to the root URL
Enable the HTTPS protocol for the web server
Use a simplified view for the server directory listing
Automatically reload the browser when project sources change. Overrides the 'liveReload' setting in the project's server configuration
Accept remote connections. By default the server only accepts connections from localhost
Path to the private key
Path to the certificate
Always send content security policies 'sap-target-level-1' and 'sap-target-level-3' in report-only mode
Collects and serves CSP reports upon request to '/.ui5/csp/csp-reports.json'

Cache mode to use for building UI5 projects. The 'Default' behavior is to always use the build-cache if available. 'Force' uses the cache only. If the build-cache is unavailable or invalid, the server will fail to build the project. 'ReadOnly' does not create or update any cache but makes use of a cache if available. 'Off' does not use any build-cache and always triggers a rebuild of the project
Overrides the framework version defined by the project. Takes the same value as the version part of "ui5 use"
As of UI5 CLI version 5, renamed to '--snapshot-cache'. Use '--snapshot-cache' to control this behavior.

Cache mode to use when consuming SNAPSHOT versions of framework dependencies. The 'Default' behavior is to invalidate the cache after 9 hours. 'Force' uses the cache only and does not create any requests. 'Off' invalidates any existing cache and updates from the repository
